nom: Saturday Skin Rub-A-Dub Refining Peel Gel Exfoliator

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe visible flaking and dead skin being lifted away, softer results, better moisturizer absorption, and repeat use for years without dryness or irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, even extremely sensitive, skin report no redness, itching or over-drying, and describe the product as gentler than comparable enzyme peels or scrubs they had tried before.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone, combination-leaning skin says the product keeps breakouts at bay without triggering new ones during travel.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s report brighter, smoother skin, reduced fine lines, and improvement in bumpy or rough texture on the face and neck.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers (40s–60s) report fewer fine lines, tighter-looking skin and a brighter, more youthful appearance after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin report the product smooths and lifts flakes without stripping moisture, and that moisturizer absorbs better afterward; one reviewer felt it did not add hydration or produce a change at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes that overusing the product (doubling up applications) caused redness, while most others report no redness or irritation even on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as non-stripping and barrier-friendly, saying it clears pores without the 'killed skin barrier' feeling of stronger exfoliants.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report improvement in dry patches, uneven texture, and hyperpigmentation or scarring from past breakouts; one reviewer specifically credits it with visibly reducing old acne scars.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the product does not cause new breakouts and helps control flare-ups (including during travel) and enlarged pores; no reviewer reports worsened acne.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically discusses oil control or shine reduction.

aspects.libelle: No visible effect for some users

extraits.texte: This item is weird. I read great reviews before I purchased. You really b it around and creates little pearls ? But, it doesn't make my skin feel any different won't purchase again.

I first got this with an IPSY package I got and I absolutely loved it. My dry skin has never felt smoother. I've seen people said stuff about the smell there really isn't a scent to it but really does get the job done with peeling all the dead dry skin off my face. Honestly I haven't found anything better especially with the price. It's Honestly worth the money.

extraits.titre: My newest MUST HAVE, holy grail skin product.
extraits.texte: This product is a MUST HAVE!! As someone who regularly uses washes, toners, serums, exfoliators and weekly masks and moisturizers, I felt I had it covered. Then I tried the dead skin peels like Yo Glow and Dr Frog's tox gel and WOW. But Saturday Skin's completely blows the others away. It's so gentle, but it absolutely works fabulously I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin, and a tiny amount massaged into my skin for a minute had flakes of dead skin showering down. After that minute and I rinsed off the product and rest of the dead skin I HAVE NEVER felt my skin SO SOFT. Incredible! Always going to stay stocked.

I tried this one time at a friends house and immediately ordered my own bottle. I've had large pores and acne scarring my whole life, and was really happy with how much cleaner this made my skin look. It even lasted for a few days. It's very satisfying to use and was really gentle. My sensitive skin didn't have any issues overdrying like with other exfoliating products I've tried. Don't expect this product to work miracles, but I doubt you'll regret adding it to your skincare routine.

extraits.titre: Incredible product! Reduced scars improved my skin!
extraits.texte: I've tried a lot of skincare products, like, a lot! This stuff work as wellbetter than expensive exfoliants. I just love it. It has reduced scars I've had on my face since popping zits as a teenager! It's a miracle. I prob use it more often than you're supposed to. It is possible to overdo it cause redness if you use it too much, but I often use to applications at one time to be thorough. I can't believe the improvement in my scars. I should have taken beforeafter pics!

extraits.titre: Great for every day and especially travel
extraits.texte: I use the rubadub as a face wash in the shower every morning. I have somewhat sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate me. It also keeps the acne at bay which tends to flare up when I travel, so I always take this with me. Its a very light scrub and takes only a small dab to wash with. I am a repeat customer of this product!

I love this stuff. It makes your face look and feel flawless. I'm 60 years old and live in a super dry climate so exfoliating is important but regular scrubs are too much. After I use this I follow with a gentle retin Avitamin C moisturizer and those fine lines are totally gone. Just twice a week like it says. Give it a try!
